answer: Full reward calls for answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 50%. Because the jade pair is tracked in the whisper ledger, the yarrow audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 192 identities means 192 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
